title: Sheaves of modules on the small Zariski site have enough injectives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] and let $\mathcal O_X$ be its structure sheaf. The category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] has enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]: every sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules admits a monomorphism into an injective sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.
